To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Technical Assistant: B.E./ B.Tech. in Mechanical Engg or Design. Assistant Project Scientist: B.Sc. Or B.Tech. In food science/ chemistry/ biotech/ agri with experience of 2 years for B.Sc., 1 year for B.Tech.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Guwahati recruitment is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: For Senior Technical Assistant, a B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or Design is required. For Assistant Project Scientist, a B.Sc. or B.Tech. in food science, chemistry, biotech, or agriculture with relevant experience is needed.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 23,025 to Rs. 28,077 per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by IIT Guwahati for the posts of Senior Technical Assistant and Assistant Project Scientist.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their application forms.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview date?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, meaning the employment is for a fixed period as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Technical Assistant and Assistant Project Scientist posts will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.
